evidence_snapshot.content: 补查 tome commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63 game/modules/tome/data/talents/techniques/pugilism.lua:39-40、66-67（Striking Stance）。源文第二句 "The offensive bonuses scale with your Dexterity" 中 offensive bonuses 为复数，指第一句列出的 Accuracy 与 striking talents 伤害倍率两项；源码 getAttack = self:getDex(25, true)、getDamage = self:combatStatScale("dex", 25, 60) 证实命中与伤害均随敏捷成长。译文「受敏捷影响，伤害按比例加成」只保留伤害一项，漏掉命中加成随敏捷成长，读者会误以为命中值固定或随他项成长。

conclusion: Contextual review independently identified translation issues.

evidence_snapshot.content: 补查 tome commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63 game/modules/tome/data/talents/misc/races.lua:788（Orc Skirmisher info）。源文 "Orcs have seen countless battles, and won many of them" 刻意区分「经历的战斗无数」与「其中赢下许多（many）」；译文「兽人经历并赢得过无数战斗」把两个分句合并，令 many 升格为「无数」，即宣称所有无数战斗均获胜，夸大并抹掉源文的对比。建议「兽人经历过无数战斗，并赢下了其中许多」。

conclusion: Contextual review independently identified translation issues.

evidence_snapshot.content: 补查 tome commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63 game/modules/tome/data/achievements/quests.lua:338-340，成就 id = "ALL_DREAMS"、name = "Dreaming my dreams"，desc 为 "Experienced and completed all the dreams in the Dogroth Caldera."。译文「经历并完成达格罗斯火山的梦境。」丢失限定词 all；该成就的达成条件是完成火山中的全部梦境（非任意一个），限定词缺失使成就条件被弱化。建议补为「……的所有梦境」。
